Founder & Managing Partner

Agaba Saimon is the visionary Founding Partner and Managing Partner of Remedium Advocates. He brings over a decade of distinguished legal experience spanning litigation, regulatory advisory, corporate law, public governance, and tax strategy. A nationally respected authority on land law, tax disputes, and legal compliance, Saimon has successfully represented clients before courts, tax tribunals, and regulatory bodies. His prior leadership as Registrar and Board Secretary at the Architects Registration Board saw him spearhead statutory reforms, where he played a leading role in coordinating stakeholder engagement on reforms to the Building Control Act and enhancing institutional collaboration with the National Building Review Board (NBRB). He is particularly lauded for his ability to blend legal precision with policy insight—and served as a legal and policy advisor to the Uganda Parliamentary Forum on Social Protection, and served as Company Secretary to leading civic and development institutions. His consultancy portfolio includes legal support to tourism associations, SMEs, NGOs, and international development projects. Saimon holds a Bachelor of Laws from Makerere University, a Postgraduate Diploma in Legal Practice, a Postgraduate Diploma in Public Administration, and certifications in Arbitration and Monitoring & Evaluation. He is currently pursuing an MBA and ICSA Company Secretarial qualification. He is a Notary Public, Commissioner for Oaths, and active member of the Uganda and East African Law Societies. His leadership defines Remedium’s professional ethos: strategy, integrity, and legal mastery.
  • Advocate of the High Court
  • Notary Public
  • Governance Expert
  • Policy Advisor
